note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 12, GAM 6-7; A06b Const 12, GAM 6-7; L05 Const 13(1)(a), GAM 10): ordinary naturalisation after 15 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen keeps it on taking another (loss applies only to naturalised citizens, not modelled). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Gambia, 2024
sources.said: Person has been ordinarily resident in The Gambia for a continuous period of not less than 15 years. Intention to permanently reside required. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required. ... Person is a citizen other than by birth or descent and acquired citizenship of another country by voluntary act other than marriage, or exercised rights accorded to citizens in that country, and it is not conducive to the public good that s/he should remain a citizen.
